news.detail: Szmyt tied things up at 3-3 with a 50-yard field goal midway through the first quarter before connecting on two 34-yard field goals across the next two quarters. It was the first time since Week 11 of the 2025 season that Szmyt connected on three field goals, and his production will likely fluctuate
